Recommendation:
Approve consent application B/08/2025 for the creation of one lot (residence surplus to an agricultural operation) containing an existing dwelling and accessory structures; that will have a lot area of approximately 3,640 m
2
and a lot frontage of approximately 40 m, subject to the following conditions:
1) That the applicant provide confirmation that a private septic system fits within the boundaries of the severed lot, to the satisfaction of the Chief Building Official;
2) That the applicant provide confirmation from a law firm, to the satisfaction of the Municipality, that existing and future owners of the merged remnant farm parcel will be able to utilize the existing access fronting 2015 Lakeshore Road 302 for farming access, which provides driveway access to a wind turbine;
3) That the applicant obtains a Reference Plan from an Ontario Land Surveyor for the severed lot to the satisfaction of the Municipality of Lakeshore. The draft plan of survey is to be reviewed by the Municipality of Lakeshore, and is required to detail the setbacks of all buildings/structures from the lot lines of the severed lot, the existing access, and is to provide confirmation that all services (water, hydro, gas, etc.) are located entirely within the property limits of the severed lot;
4) That the applicant provide confirmation from a law firm that the creation of the severed lot and merger of the remnant farmland with 2015 Lakeshore Road 302 will not impact or interfere with any existing easements or legal instruments on the title of the lands involved;
5) That all municipal taxes be paid in full prior to the stamping of the Deed;
6) That the applicant obtain a Zoning By-law amendment to rezone the remnant farmland parcel located at 2305 Lakeshore Road 302 into a zone that prohibits new dwelling(s) and additional residential unit(s) on the remnant farmland parcel;
7) That the applicant satisfy the requirements of the Drainage Services Division with respect to a Subsequent Subdivision of Land (Section 65(1) of the Drainage Act) letter prepared by a Drainage Engineer;
